summary: An update can no longer be written into a note that was just retired, and a note folded into another one now points to where its question went.
details: If a note was closed or merged while Nora was writing an update to it, the update used to land in the retired note, where nothing reads it again. The write is now refused and redone against the note that is still open.
A note merged into another note forwards to it: asking for it by its old title reaches the surviving note, and a background update aimed at it lands there instead of creating the same note again.
limitations: Nothing merges notes automatically yet; this prepares for the note-merge pass (design 41 section 7).
